The Empty Chum Bucket is an item that can be placed down and filled with  Chum. Full Chum Buckets can be used to buy items from Moby.

Obtaining

[edit | edit source]

An Empty Chum Bucket can be bought from Moby for  8 Glowing Mushrooms and 2,000 Coins.

Usage

[edit | edit source]

Fishing

[edit | edit source]

Empty Chum Buckets can be placed next to  Water. While any player's Chum Bucket is placed nearby, Sea Creatures killed by the player will drop  1 Chum. The amount of Chum dropped is increased by 1 per nearby Chum Bucket, up to 4.

The player can right click on their or another player's Chum Bucket to deposit their Chum. They will gain 20 Coins and +10  Fishing XP per Chum, which can be increased by the  Luminous Bracelet if the Chum is deposited into another player's Chum Bucket. Once the player's Chum Bucket has 10 Chum in it, it can be picked up, and will become a Full Chum Bucket.

If the player walks too far away from their placed Chum Bucket or warps to a different server, it will be automatically picked up, causing it to lose all Chum inside of it, even if it was full.

Moby

[edit | edit source]

Full Chum Buckets can be used to buy items from Moby.

Crafting

[edit | edit source]

A Full Chum Bucket can be alternatively obtained by crafting.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]

The Chum Bucket is a reference to the TV show Spongebob Squarepants, where Plankton owns a restaurant called the Chum Bucket.
